description_en: Thehitiis located in the north-east of Nāga Bāhāḥ and dates back to the Licchavi period. The hiti's three stone spouts face east and feature engravings ofmakaras. A small stone statue ofAkṣobhyais enshrined in a niche above the central spout. Above this niche is a Licchavicaitya. On the northern wall is aJaruñhiti(water tank and spout for drinking water). At the north-east corner, there are acaturmukha(caturvyūha) caitya,and an underground room which is sectioned off by a small gate made of iron rods. This underground room is called Mandaḥphalcā; it may once have been used as a place to rest whilst filling water, but is now filled with garbage. In the south-facing wall of the Mandaḥphalcais a stone image of a standing Buddha. Two stone elephants can be found above the small gate.At the south-east corner of thehitione can find anavagrahamaṇḍalaand two emptyjalahari(stone pedestals). Above the pedestals and on the wall are statues of Gaṇeśa, Viṣṇu and an unidentified image. One can enter thehitivia a modern brick gate located at the south-east corner. An electric light pole was installed in the centre of thehitiduring the Rāṇā period.In the 1990s, thehitiand sections of its supply lines were renovated through the German-funded project Urban Development through Local Effort (UDLE). (Furukawa2010, 48)In the past water from thehitiwas used for rituals during theSamyakfestival, however, nowadays there is no water flowing during the dry season. Thehitiprovides small amounts of water only during the rainy season. Since the drainage is blocked polluted water collects below the spouts.
description_ne: यो हिटी नाग बाहा:बाट उत्तर-पूर्व दिशामा अवस्थित छ । यो हिटी लिच्छविकालमा निर्माण गरिएको हो । जमिनको सतहभन्दा मुनि तीनवटा ढुङ्गे धारा छन् । यी तीनै वटा धाराहरूमा गोहीका आकृति कुँदिएका छन् । बीचको धारामाथि रहेको प्रतिमा स्थानमा अक्षोभ्यको सानो मूर्ति राखिएको छ । त्यो प्रतिमा स्थान भन्दामाथि सानो लिच्छवि चैत्य रहेको छ । उत्त्रपट्टिको पर्खालमा जरुँहिटी छ । यस हिटीको उत्तर-पूर्वी कुनामा चतुर्व्यूह चैत्य रहेको छ । उत्तर-पूर्वी कुनापट्टि नै एउटा जमिनको  सतहभन्दा मुनि एउटा सानो फलामे ढोका भएको कोठा छ । यो कोठालाई मन्दः फल्चा भनिन्छ । सम्भवतः यो पानी भर्दै गर्दा बस्नको लागि बनाइएको हो । त्यस ढोकामाथि हात्तीका दुईवटा ढुङ्गाका मूर्तिहरू छन् । लोककथन अनुसार पाटनका राजाले यीनै हात्तीमाथि बसेर  सम्यक्-नामक जात्रा हेर्ने गर्दथे । मन्दः फल्चाको दक्षिणी पर्खालमा बुद्धको उभिएको मूर्ति छ । यो हिटीको दक्षिण-पूर्वी कुनामा नवग्रहमण्डल र दुईवटा जलहरी रहेका छन् । ती जलहरीमाथि पर्खालमा गणेश र विष्णुका प्रतिमा रहेका छन् र त्यसको नजिकै एउटा अर्को प्रतिमा छ जुन कुन देवताको हो भन्ने निश्चय गर्न सकिएन, सायद त्यो प्रतिमा कृष्णको हुनुपर्दछ । हिटीको मध्य भागमा एउटा बिजुलीको खम्बा छ, जुन राणाकालमा गाडिएको हो । पहिला सम्यक्-जात्रामा यस हिटीको पानी लगेर चढाउने प्रचलन थियो तर आजभोलि सुख्खा याममा हिटीमा पानी आउँदैन भने वर्षायाममा पनि सानो मात्रै आउँछ । सन् १९९० को दशकमा जर्मनीको अनुदानमा यो हिटीको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो । सन् २००८ मा फेरि पनि एउटा अमेरिकी संस्थाको सहयोगमा यो हिटीको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो ।

historical_events.event_description: The inscription is badly eroded and cannot be read.
Renovation of thehitiby the local community
Renovation of the water supply lines and installation of a storage system with funds provided by the German-funded Urban Development through Local Effort (UDLE) Project.
The renovation was managed by the Nāga Bāhāḥ Hiti user group with funds from the US Ambassadors Fund for Cultural Preservation
